title: 安田記念の後に・新たながっぷり！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The clash of titans has the crowd on the edge of their seats! It seems people have realized Hishi Akebono's races are in a league of their own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle and Hishi Akebono are just as satisfied with their all-out battle for the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They swear that this won't be their last battle together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our next race is set for the Sprinters S. It's time to prepare for the rematch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Hishi Akebono has noticed an odd sensation in her legs.
